finite_failure_conditions.CB_owned_FX_zero_and_no_other_willing_so: Imported20FU cannot settle under ANY regime; no authorized par conversion, private pooling or invoice erasure.
finite_failure_conditions.foreign_supplier_refuses_CU: New CU does not meet its FU invoice; a willing FX source, repricing or protected lawful substitution is needed.
finite_failure_conditions.bond_buyer_refuses: Authorization/auction is not settlement; source-specific lawful interim finance is needed before actual payment.
finite_failure_conditions.qualified_provider_absent: One nominally financed package does not create safe workers/equipment; actual remedy and elected capacity choice remain.
finite_failure_conditions.higher_issue_or_rate_to_repair_outcome: Neither is automatically authorized by a missed target, a model or technical office.
